title: Blocked worker recovery through the gateway
description: Use a disposable gateway, run ledger, project, and slot to verify blocked-monitor refusals, find-slot restart, and an assessed new attempt that completes monitoring. No operator runs or slots are used.

replay-gateway.intent: Send run.replayStep, runtime.capability.acquire and run.probeWorkerSignal to an isolated gateway; read run.get and fleet.status to prove stale attempts are refused, restart releases the slot, and an assessed fresh attempt completes monitoring.
